title: Y-Band Expansion Playbook — Targeted Dedicated/Private Upgrades + SLA Outreach
content:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for accounts in the Y-Band (mid-enterprise: ~50k-250k ARR) that show signs of scaling inference usage and are good candidates for: (A) Dedicated capacity reservations, (B) Private/VPC deployments, and/or (C) premium SLA add-ons.

Intended audience:
- CSMs managing mid-enterprise book-of-business
- Solutions Engineers (pre/post-sale) for technical validation
- Renewal and Growth sellers for contract structuring

When to use / triggers (signals):
- Sustained hosted API spend > $15k/month for 3 consecutive months OR growing >25% month-over-month
- Consistent tail latency or token volume spikes tied to peak business hours (observability traces show 40%+ variance)
- Data residency/compliance ask (SOC2 + specific region requirements) OR procurement push for on-prem/VPC
- Repeated rate-limiting incidents or burst throttles impacting SLA-sensitive UX
- Customer mentions TCO concerns and willingness to commit for cost predictability

Quick qualification checklist (fast screen - t/f):
- Uses Redwood for product-critical path: T/F
- Average request concurrency > 50: T/F
- Has internal procurement lead interested in multi-year commitments: T/F
- Requires private network controls (VPC/HSM): T/F
- Has latency SLA expectations documented: T/F

QBR / Expansion discovery agenda (20–30 min expansion slot inside QBR):
1) Recap current usage & cost profile (CSM) — 5m
2) Performance & pain points (SRE/SE input) — 7m
3) Business impact of observed issues (CSM) — 3m
4) Proposal options: Dedicated / Private / SLA tiers (Growth) — 8m
5) Next steps & owners — 2m

Suggested talking points (CSM):
- "We’re seeing predictable growth on your inference workloads; we can reduce per-token cost and stabilize latency by moving to a Dedicated pool or a Private deployment."
- "With a dedicated setup we can guarantee tail latency SLOs and reserve capacity during your peak windows — that maps directly to fewer timeouts and better end-user conversion."

Pricing and commitment structure (example tiers - replace with official pricing):
- Dedicated Starter: 2x reserved GPUs, burst into shared for spikes, 12-month commit -> ~20% discount vs on-demand hosted at scale
- Dedicated Plus: 6x reserved GPUs, priority routing, included 24/7 incident bridge, 12–24 month commit -> ~30% discount
- Private Basic: VPC private control plane, customer-managed networking, quarterly security reviews, 12-month -> baseline infra fee + integration effort
- SLA Premium: 99.9% uptime SLA + 2hr P1 response, enhanced logging retention, dedicated TAM -> applied to any Dedicated/Private contract as an add-on

Sample ROI pitch (short):
- Convert token cost savings + reduced error-rate into monthly dollars: e.g., hosted to Dedicated Starter saves $12k/mo at current volume + avoids ~$6k/mo in lost revenue from timeouts = net $18k/mo improvement.

Outreach cadence & owner responsibilities:
- Trigger: Automated alert from billing/usage > threshold -> CSM gets ping (owner: CSM)
- Week 0: Intro call + usage review (owner: CSM + SE)
- Week 1: Technical deep-dive + capacity planning (owner: SE)
- Week 2: Draft commercial proposal + legal kick-off (owner: Growth + Legal)
- Week 3–5: Negotiation / procurement cycles -> loop in Accounts for terms (owner: Growth)

Renewal tracker snippet (to paste into spreadsheet quickly):
- Customer, Current ARR, Avg Monthly Usage, Peak Concurrency, Observed Issues, Opportunity(DED/Private/SLA), Commercial Owner, Next Step, Estimated Close Date, Risk
- Example row: AcmeCorp, $120k, 1.2M tokens/mo, concurrency 120, sporadic timeouts, Dedicated Plus + SLA, Ben Turner, Technical deep-dive 2025-02-10, Medium

Technical validation checklist (SE):
- Confirm model compatibility & resource estimate (GPU type, batch targets)
- Verify KV cache patterns and whether prefix caching will reduce cost
- Latency profiling with representative traffic (p95/p99)
- Security constraints: KMS/HSM needs, network egress, IP allowlists
- Migration plan: phased rollout, canary routing, rollback plan

Common objections + suggested rebuttals:
- "We don’t want long-term lock-in." -> "We build in rolling windows and version pinning so you can migrate; committed discounts are exchangeable into credits for other Redwood services under defined conditions."
- "On-prem sounds risky for our team." -> "We offer a Private-managed option where Redwood operates the control plane in your VPC and provides runbooks and a knowledge transfer cadence."
- "We can manage cheaper on our own infra." -> "Factor in the ops uplift and the team time to maintain kernels/quantization/fast-paths; Redwood’s runtime reduces per-token cost and time-to-resolution for incidents."

Playbook flow (high level):
1) Alert -> 2) CSM quick qual -> 3) Discovery call + technical profiling -> 4) Proposal + internal pricing approval -> 5) Contracting + legal -> 6) Implementation kickoff -> 7) QBR follow-up & success KPIs

Implementation checklist (first 90 days):
- Week 0–2: Kickoff, network setup, contract signed
- Week 2–4: Dedicated pool provisioning or Private control plane deploy in staging
- Week 4–6: Canary traffic, latency checks, fallback test
- Week 6–10: Full cutover + monitoring dashboard (console links)
- Week 10–12: Post-cutover review, performance tuning, cost reconciliation

Success metrics to promise & monitor:
- p95 latency improvement (target: -30% vs hosted baseline)
- Token unit cost reduction (target: -20% after optimization)
- Error & timeout reduction (target: -90% for observed issues)
- Time to incident response (SLA tier dependent)

Templates (short):
- Intro email (CSM -> customer):
  Subject: "Usage trends & options to improve performance/cost for [Customer]"
  Body: "Quick note — we’ve been tracking growth in your inference traffic and have a few deployment options that can reduce cost and improve reliability. Can we schedule a 30-minute review next week? I’ll bring the SE for a quick technical profile."

- SE ask before call (bullets):
  - Sample 1-week traffic (start/end timestamps)
  - Representative payload sizes and model names
  - Current error/timeout logs for last 30 days

Notes to self (draft work items):
- Create definitive pricing sheet for Dedicated Starter/Plus/Private and SLA add-ons (owner: Growth)
- Add canned Delta & ROI calculator into CSM toolbelt (owner: Product Ops)
- Build Looker dashboard to auto-flag Y-Band expansion candidates (owner: Analytics)
- Validate Private deployment checklist with infra-engineering (owner: Solutions Eng)

Open questions (for Thursday sync):
- Can we offer a trial Dedicated pool for 30 days with a performance SLA? legal and infra implications?
- How do we bill networking egress in Private deployments for EU customers?

Appendix: quick links (working):
- Renewal tracker (sheet): GDrive:customer-success/renewal-tracker-2025
- Pricing reference draft: CONFLUENCE:CS/DEDICATED-PRICING-DRAFT-2025
